اغتربا (form VIII)

# اُغْتُرِبَا (uḡturibā) /uɣ.tu.ri.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# اِغْتَرِبَا (iḡtaribā) /iɣ.ta.ri.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
